snippet.title: LEGO Fortnite Expeditions - Super Gameplay Trailer

Welcome to Supernova Academy! Choose your path of study and team up to complete 4-player Missions in Expeditions. Discover the three Hero Classes, Academy Assignments, new weapons and more here: http://fn.gg/LFN-Expeditions
